prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Redraw only cell 2, the right one (the transparent area). Keep cell 1 exactly as it is, and match its style, colours and fine detail.

The fault in cell 2: the light well was drawn in perspective — its four inner walls with rows of windows are visible, as if seen at an angle, and each dormer shows its window front. The view is straight down: a light well is only its flat floor, a small square of grey paving about 7 × 5 m in the middle, with a thin dark edge and no wall and no window visible at all. Each dormer is a small gabled roof about 1.5 m wide seen from directly above, its two slopes and ridge only, no window face.

Trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions and its widely rounded corners, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. Details at true size: a building next to cars 4 m long; a chimney stack about 0.6–1 m, roof courses about 0.25 m apart. No text.
